title: 第23章 颠倒黑白第24章 回天剑宗报仇
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
“叛徒李易？”
闻言，李易面色一僵，满脸惊愕，他什么时候成叛徒了？
李凡也有些发呆，不知道这是怎么回事。
这时，这名执法堂的弟子看清了李易的面容，整个人愣了愣，然后醒悟过来，激动道：“你就是叛徒李易吧。”
他看过李易的画像，面前这名俊美高挑的男子与画像上的人一模一样。
“我什么时候成叛徒了？”
李易感到莫名其妙，他消失了三年，才回来一个月，都没有回天剑宗，哪有机会成叛徒。
“还在狡辩。”
执法堂弟子神色愠怒，一把抓向李易，冷声道：“随我去见执法堂长老，接受惩罚。”
李易推开他的手臂，漠然道：“我自己会走，你带路就行了。”
执法堂弟子面色一寒，“不行，执法堂长老说过，要捆着你去见他。”
说罢，他再次抓向李易，这一次动用了真气，手上力道重了许多。
“砰。”
执法堂弟子被李易给一拳打飞出去，跌落在地，这一幕惊动了逛街的人群，他们纷纷散开，充满好奇与惊讶地望着两人。
“你居然敢对执法堂的人动手，真是反了天了。”
执法堂弟子脸色通红，翻身而起，眼里冒起怒火，手持灵器长剑，用真气使出剑诀，朝李易攻来。
李易不想与这种不明真相的人纠缠，身如灵蛇，轻松躲过对方的攻击，然后一把扣住其手腕的脉门，寒声道：“你再不分青红皂白动手，我就废了你右手的经脉，让你一辈子都无法握剑。”
说罢，一把推开对方。
执法堂弟子噔噔退后几步，面色一阵青一阵白，想发怒，却又不敢，经过两次交手，他知道自己远不是李易的对手，再出手就是自取其辱。
“林师弟，发生了什么？”

这时，街上有几个身穿执法堂服饰的人闻声赶来，看见脸色难看的执法堂弟子，立即询问。
执法堂林姓弟子怒声道：“李易出现了，但他拒捕，还对我动手。”
几人目光盯着空地上的俊美少年，目光一凝，其中一名中年人喝道：“叛徒李易，赶紧束手就擒，否则别怪我们心狠手辣。”
“你们带路，我要去见执法堂长老，问问我什么时候成叛徒了。”
李易想知道自己到底犯了什么罪，被天剑宗列为叛徒，还出动如此多的执法堂弟子前来抓捕，最弱的都是先天境后期。
中年人强硬道：“你束手就擒，我们自然会带你去见长老。”
“你们是不是找打，我哥犯了什么罪，被你们一口一个叛徒叫着。”
李凡愤怒走来，瞪着大眼，俯视面前的几名执法堂弟子，高大的躯体与凌厉的气势给人一种强烈的压迫感。
“将他们一起抓起来。”
中年人是一名元府境中期修士，并未被高大的李凡吓住，直接动手。
“砰。”
中年人被李凡一巴掌拍飞了。
其他五名执法堂弟子还没来得及出手，见此一幕，当场呆滞了，瞠目结舌地盯着李凡，感到极为不可思议，这可是执法堂执事，一名元府境高手啊，就这样被无情地拍飞了？
“你配抓我哥吗？”
李凡居高临下盯着中年人，一脸轻蔑。
中年人双拳紧握，眼里满是怒火，就要祭出下品玄器长剑，动用杀招。
“我劝你别妄动，否则我可能会杀了你。”
李易如鬼魅般来到中年人面前，手中的玄器长剑直指其咽喉。
“你敢杀我吗？”
中年人眼中冒火，但没有继续动手，李凡的强大肉身，以及李易的诡异身法，都让他十分忌惮。
content_en:
"Traitor Li Yi?"
Hearing this, Li Yi's face froze, and his face was full of shock. When did he become a traitor?
Li Fan was also in a daze, wondering what was going on.
At this time, the disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall saw Li Yi's face clearly and was stunned. Then he woke up and said excitedly: "You must be the traitor Li Yi."
He had seen Li Yi's portrait, and the handsome and tall man in front of him was exactly the same as the person in the portrait.
"When did I become a traitor?"
Li Yi felt baffled. He disappeared for three years and only came back for a month. He never returned to Tianjian Sect. How could he become a traitor?
"Still quibbling."
The disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall looked angry, grabbed Li Yi, and said coldly: "Follow me to see the elder of the Law Enforcement Hall and accept the punishment."
Li Yi pushed his arm away and said indifferently: "I can walk by myself, you can just lead the way."
The disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall looked cold, "No, the elder of the Law Enforcement Hall has said that he will tie you up to see him."
After that, he grabbed Li Yi again, this time using his true energy, and his hand was much heavier.
"Bang."
The disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall was punched by Li Yi and fell to the ground. This scene shocked the shopping crowd. They dispersed and looked at the two people with curiosity and surprise.
"You actually dare to attack someone from the Law Enforcement Hall. You are really going against the grain."
The face of the disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall turned red, and he stood up, with anger in his eyes. He held the spiritual weapon long sword in his hand, used his true energy to use the sword technique, and attacked Li Yi.
Li Yi didn't want to get entangled with such a person who didn't know the truth. He was like a snake and easily dodged the opponent's attack. Then he grabbed the pulse gate of his wrist and said in a cold voice: "If you do it indiscriminately, I will destroy the meridians in your right hand and make you unable to hold a sword for the rest of your life."
After that, he pushed the other person away.
The disciple of the Law Enforcement Hall took a few steps back, his face turning green and white. He wanted to get angry, but he didn't dare. After two fights, he knew that he was far from Li Yi's opponent, and he would be humiliating himself if he took action again.
"Junior Brother Lin, what happened?"
At this time, several people wearing Law Enforcement Hall uniforms heard the noise and came over on the street. When they saw the ugly-faced Law Enforcement Hall disciples, they immediately asked.
A disciple named Lin from the Law Enforcement Hall said angrily: "Li Yi showed up, but he resisted arrest and even attacked me."
Several people stared at the handsome young man in the open space, their eyes focused, and one of the middle-aged men shouted: "Traitor Li Yi, hurry up and capture him, otherwise don't blame us for being ruthless."
"You guys lead the way, I'm going to see the elders of the Law Enforcement Hall and ask when I became a traitor."
Li Yi wanted to know what crime he had committed. He was listed as a traitor by the Tianjian Sect. So many disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall were dispatched to arrest him. The weakest ones were all in the late Xiantian realm.
The middle-aged man said forcefully: "If you just surrender, we will naturally take you to see the elders."
"Are you looking for a beating? What crime did my brother commit and you call him a traitor?"
Li Fan came angrily, staring down at the law enforcement hall disciples in front of him with big eyes. His tall body and fierce momentum gave people a strong sense of oppression.
"Catch them all together."
The middle-aged man was a monk in the middle stage of Yuanfu Realm. He was not intimidated by the tall Li Fan and took action directly.
"Bang."
The middle-aged man was slapped away by Li Fan.
Before the other five Law Enforcement Hall disciples had time to take action, they were stunned when they saw this scene. They stared at Li Fan with dumbfounded eyes. They felt extremely unbelievable. This was the deacon of the Law Enforcement Hall, a Yuanfu Realm master, and was mercilessly shot away like this?
"Are you worthy of arresting my brother?"
Li Fan stared down at the middle-aged man with contempt on his face.
The middle-aged man clenched his fists and his eyes were full of anger. He was about to take out the long sword, a low-grade mysterious weapon, and use his killing move.
"I advise you not to act rashly, otherwise I may kill you."
Li Yi came to the middle-aged man like a ghost, with the mysterious sword in his hand pointed directly at his throat.
"Do you dare to kill me?"
middle-aged eyesHe was furious, but did not continue to take action. Li Fan's powerful body and Li Yi's weird body skills made him very afraid.
